title: Echinacoside exerts neuroprotection via suppressing microglial alpha-synuclein/TLR2/NF-kappaB/NLRP3 axis in parkinsonian models.
authors: Yang, Xue-Ping; Huang, Jia-Hua; Ye, Fan-Long; Yv, Qing-Yun; Chen, Sheng; Li, Wen-Wei; Zhu, Min
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究松果菊苷在帕金森模型中通过抑制小胶质细胞alpha-synuclein/TLR2/NF-kappaB/NLRP3轴发挥神经保护作用，属于神经炎症机制研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Echinacoside (ECH), a natural active compound, was found to exert neuroprotection in Parkinson's disease (PD). However, the underlying molecular mechanisms remain controversial. PURPOSE: This study aimed to explore the roles of ECH in PD and its engaged mechanisms. CONCLUSION: In vivo, MPTP was adapted to construct subacute PD mouse model to explore the regulation of ECH on NLRP3 inflammasome. In vitro, alpha-synuclein (alpha-syn)/MPP(+) was used to mediate the activation of NLRP3 inflammasome in BV2 cells, and the mechanism of ECH regulation of it was explored with molecular docking, immunofluorescence, Western blotting, and small molecule inhibitors. CONCLUSION: The activation of microglial NLRP3 inflammasome could be evoked by MPTP in vitro, but its toxic metabolite MPP(+) alone cannot trigger the activation of NLRP3 inflammasome in vitro, which requires alpha-synuclein (alpha-syn) priming. Exogenous alpha-syn could evoke microglial TLR2/NF-kappaB/NLRP3 axis, playing the priming role in MPP(+) -mediated NLRP3 inflammasome activation. ECH can suppress the upregulation of alpha-syn in MPTP-treated mice and BV2 microglia. It can also suppress the activation of the TLR2/NF-kappaB/NLRP3 axis induced by alpha-syn. CONCLUSION: ECH exerts neuroprotective effects by downregulating the TLR2/NF-kappaB/NLRP3 axis via reducing the expression of alpha-syn in the PD models.
abstract_zh: 背景：毛蕊花糖苷（Echinacoside, ECH）作为一种天然活性化合物，在帕金森病（Parkinson's disease, PD）中被发现具有神经保护作用。然而，其潜在的分子机制仍存在争议。目的：本研究旨在探讨ECH在PD中的作用及其参与的机制。结论：在体内实验中，采用MPTP构建亚急性PD小鼠模型，以探讨ECH对NLRP3炎症小体的调控作用。在体外实验中，利用α-突触核蛋白（alpha-synuclein, alpha-syn）/MPP(+)介导BV2细胞中NLRP3炎症小体的激活，并通过分子对接、免疫荧光、蛋白质印迹法和小分子抑制剂探讨ECH对其的调控机制。结论：MPTP在体内可诱发小胶质细胞NLRP3炎症小体的激活，但其毒性代谢物MPP(+)单独在体外不能触发NLRP3炎症小体的激活，这需要α-突触核蛋白（alpha-syn）的启动作用。外源性alpha-syn可激发小胶质细胞TLR2/NF-kappaB/NLRP3轴，在MPP(+)介导的NLRP3炎症小体激活中发挥启动作用。ECH可抑制MPTP处理小鼠和BV2小胶质细胞中alpha-syn的上调，同时也能抑制alpha-syn诱导的TLR2/NF-kappaB/NLRP3轴的激活。结论：ECH通过降低PD模型中alpha-syn的表达，下调TLR2/NF-kappaB/NLRP3轴，从而发挥神经保护作用。
